caption:
For many women, the hardest part of travelling alone isn't the flight or the safety. It's dinner.

The fear is being looked at. In reality, most people are busy with their own food, their own company and their own phones. Restaurants serve solo guests every day.

Here's what to say at the door. Then order the dessert. ☕

Have you ever eaten out alone? How did it feel?

#solotravel #solofemaletravel #tableforone #travelalone #womenwhotravel #solodining #confidence #booksforwomen

slides.subtitle: Words for a table for one.

slides.quote: Hello! A table for one, please. Could I sit by the window if there's one free?

slides.heading: Make it easier
slides.body:
Start with lunch.
Choose a counter, a market hall or a busy café.
Go a little before the dinner rush.
Book if it takes away the moment at the door.

slides.title: Say it with a smile.
slides.body:
As if it's the most normal
thing in the world. Because it is.
